verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a broad programmatic surface: REST APIs for orders, payments, subscriptions, invoicing and disputes, plus agent tools for refunds, disputes, shipments and catalog writes, and a live MCP server. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that this matches the UI, and onboarding to the agentic commerce services runs through a contact form rather than an API. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or coverage map, API-based onboarding and access provisioning for agentic commerce services, API coverage of account and settings management, independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: REST APIs, including orders, payments, subscriptions, invoicing, and disputes
Integrate with PayPal APIs to access orders, invoices, subscriptions, shipment tracking, transaction details, and dispute management through pre-built functions.
Catalog-management tools (create_product, list_product, show_product_details) let agents write to the PayPal product catalog itself.
